Package game.crops

Class Tomato

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.Ground
game.plants.Plant
game.crops.Crop
game.crops.Tomato
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Harvestable, Purchasable, Producing, Regressible, Spreading, FreelyWaterable
public class Tomato extends Crop implements Purchasable, Producing, Spreading
A tomato crop. Unlike the other crops in this world, it can only be harvested, not watered.

It can do two things by itself, in priority order:

  1. every 7 turns, dropping a tomato on an adjacent tile;
  2. every 20 turns, a 10% chance of planting another Tomato on an adjacent tile.
It is mature only and has no earlier stage, so when it is regressed it dies and leaves Dirt.
